basic_info.description: Sun-filled corner-lot home offers classic charm and exciting potential in a quiet, sunny pocket of the city. Flooded with natural light, this 1920s gem features inlaid hardwood floors, coved ceilings, and a flexible layout--including a formal living room that could easily convert into a second bedroom. The kitchen boasts cherry wood cabinetry, recessed lighting & skylight tube that brightens the space. Versatile nook is a perfect breakfast spot, home office, or pet lounge and flows seamlessly to a porch & the low-maintenance yard. Spacious 2-car garage has high ceilings and an underground cellar, ideal for storage or wine room. Some newer windows & updated systems. The flat corner lot is full of possibilities--extend the home, add an ADU, design a private outdoor retreat, or utilize the existing curb cut for a second driveway. Close to McLaren Park--one of SF's largest green spaces w/over 300 acres of trails with sweeping views, pickleball & tennis courts, off-leash dog areas, reservoir/ponds & public golf course. Near neighborhood faves: Hey Neighbor Cafe, Breakfast at Tiffany's & the San Bruno Ave corridor. Easy access to 101/280 and public transit. Walk Score: 86. Enjoy the best of laid-back city living with room to grow, a rare opportunity in the desirable Portola district.
